ai.title: Datalab Releases OmniParseBench: An Open OCR Benchmark With 16,288 Pass/Fail Tests to Audit OCR Parsers
ai.brief: Datalab has released OmniParseBench , an open OCR benchmark for document parsers. It scores parsers with 16,288 yes/no tests on 2,937 pages from 2,343 documents. The pages span 92 languages. The dataset and code are public. It helps engineers answer a sharper question than a leaderboard does: which parser handles documents like mine? 8 Flash. Is it deployable? Yes. OmniParseBench is an evaluation harness, not a model. 11+, and scores outputs offline with no API keys. OmniParseBench is a document-parsing benchmark from Datalab where every test is a yes/no question about 1 page. A parser’s score is the share of tests it passes. Datalab built it to be clear, auditable and explorable.

sec.title: Ivanti ICS Zero-Day Attacks Highlight Vendor Patching Hurdles
sec.brief: CVE-2026-104935, a high-severity authentication bypass + RCE vulnerability, was only partially discovered and patched in July, leaving an opening for threat actors to capitalize on.
